meta.description: Five product experiences told from the inside: the context I found, the decisions I made and how they turned out. Emendu, KUOTIP, INDYA, Freepik and TheTool.

title: My Experience
lead: A CV fits on two pages because it leaves out what actually gets judged: not what you did, but why you chose that and not something else. These five tell the whole thing, including what did not work.

intro.title: All five follow the same order

partes.texto: What I found when I arrived: the team, the product and the problem nobody had closed.
What I chose and what I ruled out, judged by what I knew then and not by what I know now.
The numbers with their window stated: how much, over how long and against what baseline.
Including the ones from what did not work, which are the ones that say how you decide.

ctaNota: The rest of my career (agency work and Marketing & Growth) is in the Career section of the home page and in the CV.
